title: Shirt collar with a separate stand, men's proportions

doc.h_cb: stand height at the centre back
doc.h_cf: stand height at the front end
doc.rise: how much the stand's neck edge curves up at the front
doc.fall_cb: fall (collar) height at the centre back; stand + 1 to 1.5 so the fall covers the stand
doc.spring: rise of the fall's neck edge at the front
doc.lean: angle of the collar point from the vertical, towards the front, degrees
doc.fall_short: the fall's neck edge stops this short of the stand's front end
doc.turn_of_cloth: upper collar larger than the under collar by this

provenance.notes: Values inside the ranges of the technique sheet; the outline they give was not compared to a published draft.
